headline: As of 2026-10-19: 10,254,792 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 40 of 50 states, D+18.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 10,254,792 early/mail ballots cast so far across 40 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+18.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,414,541), Florida (1,060,246), Georgia (987,257).
